$comment: Stable public URL (post-U7, not yet live): https://sdk.spur.app/schema/spur-app.schema.json. Hand-authored against the serde definitions in crates/spur-notebook/src/spur_app.rs (SpurAppManifest, SpurAppCapabilities, SpurAppCapabilityPorts, SpurAppDependencies, SpurAppMcpServer, SpurAppRuntime, SpurAppWidgetAsset, SpurAppPorts). Generation from Rust types is planned for a follow-up task (U7). When the generated schema ships, this file will be replaced and the $comment updated.
title: spur-app.json
description: Manifest for a Spur notebook app bundle (.spurapp). Schema version spur.app/v1.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Must be the literal string 'spur.app/v1'.

name.description: Human-readable app name. Used as the MCP server name.

entry_notebook.description: Relative path (within the bundle) to the entry .ipynb notebook. Must be a safe relative path with no '..' components.

open_mode.description: How the host opens this bundle. 'app' is the standard app mode.

widgets.description: Widget JS/CSS assets bundled with the app.

ports.description: Port snapshot options. null means no snapshots are bundled.

dependencies.description: Paths to language-specific dependency lock files within the bundle.

mcp_server.description: MCP server configuration. null means the app has no Python/external server.

capabilities.description: Capability declarations for host provisioning. Absent fields default to off. Unknown keys are rejected by the host.

skill.description: Relative path to the agent skill file for this app. Defaults to 'skill/SKILL.md' when absent (null).

jute_min.description: Minimum host version required, as a semver string (e.g. '0.1.0').

features.description: Deprecated feature flags (honored but ignored for gating; use capabilities instead). Doctor will warn if present.

SpurAppWidgetAsset.description: A bundled widget JS (or CSS) asset.

module.description: Archive-relative path to the JS module, e.g. 'widgets/sha256-<hash>.js'.

css.description: Archive-relative path to the companion CSS file, or null for JS-only assets.

include_snapshots.description: Whether port snapshots were included at pack time.

manifest.description: Archive-relative path to the bundled ports/manifest.json, or null if none was captured.

SpurAppDependencies.description: Paths to bundled dependency lock files (relative to the archive root, under env/).

python.description: Bundled Python lock file path (e.g. 'env/uv.lock' or 'env/requirements.txt').

SpurAppMcpServer.description: MCP server configuration for the app plugin.

type.description: Server runtime type. Currently 'python' is the only supported value.

entry.description: Archive-relative path to the server entry point (e.g. 'server/main.py').

requirements.description: Archive-relative path to the Python requirements file used to set up the venv.

env.description: Static env vars injected into the plugin process at spawn. Host-provisioned vars (SPUR_PORTS_ROOT, SPUR_ARTIFACTS_DIR) are merged after these (host wins on conflict).

SpurAppCapabilities.description: Capability declarations. All fields default to off/null. IMPORTANT: additionalProperties is false — the host rejects any unknown key with a structured error rather than silently ignoring it.

ports.description: Port-store capability. When present the host injects SPUR_PORTS_ROOT at plugin spawn.

canvas_capture.description: When true, the host guarantees the canvas-capture recorder loop end-to-end (requires active_output_scripts).

active_output_scripts.description: When true, the host shows a one-time per-app trust prompt; on grant, output iframes run with allow-scripts allow-same-origin.

artifacts_dir.description: When true, the host injects SPUR_ARTIFACTS_DIR at plugin spawn and creates the directory.

SpurAppCapabilityPorts.description: Read/write port name lists for the ports capability.

read.description: Port names the app will read from the port store.

write.description: Port names the app will write to the port store.
